method.conditions: Owner maintained unlocked Mac and engine frontmost with no other heavy workload; no input requested. caffeinate -dimsu used. No concurrent build during measurements.
method.selection: Discard first two windows; retain every complete 120-frame window entirely inside 30–140 seconds of in-level elapsed time. In-level origin is reconstructed from first window duration and subsequent monotonic receipt times.
method.tick_metric: sum(sim_tick window averages) / sum(ticks window averages); each retained window has 120 frames. Spread = max(case tick cost)/min(case tick cost) - 1.
method.AC25_judgement: Every retained window average must meet budget; report mean and range. particle_sim exclusive is parent minus nested environment per window.
method.timer_resolution: Log durations have 0.001 ms precision; ticks averages have 0.1 tick precision.

particle_sim_exclusive.availability: nested environment absent; no subtraction reported
